## Task / Tarea
Explain exactly what should change and why.

## Scope / Alcance
Identify relevant files and avoid unrelated changes.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Improvement is accurate and useful
- [ ] Examples use fictional data
- [ ] No claims of live GHL/n8n testing without evidence
- [ ] Tests or screenshots included when appropriate

Please read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md).
